CANONICAL_NAME.value: particles 0.4 -- sequential Monte Carlo / particle filtering in Python (Nicolas Chopin)

value.lineage: Particle filtering (Gordon, Salmond, Smith 1993 bootstrap filter; Doucet et al.) as the companion code to Chopin & Papaspiliopoulos, An Introduction to Sequential Monte Carlo (2020): state-space models, resampling schemes (multinomial, residual, stratified, systematic), SMC samplers, particle MCMC.

value.built_to: track a hidden state through nonlinear, non-Gaussian dynamics by propagating and reweighting a cloud of hypotheses
value.pressure: hidden state, noisy observations, models where the Kalman filter's Gaussian assumption fails; weight degeneracy fought by resampling
value.success_means: the weighted cloud's mean tracks the true posterior mean; on the linear-Gaussian case it matches the Kalman filter to Monte-Carlo error

value.pressure: hidden state, observation noise, nonlinearity, particle degeneracy
value.failure_condition: weight degeneracy: one particle carries all the weight and the estimate collapses

ANCESTRY.value: Particle filtering (Gordon, Salmond, Smith 1993 bootstrap filter; Doucet et al.) as the companion code to Chopin & Papaspiliopoulos, An Introduction to Sequential Monte Carlo (2020): state-space models, resampling schemes (multinomial, residual, stratified, systematic), SMC samplers, particle MCMC.
